*It was the same as always, you were walking through the park on your way back to your dorm after class, when you heard the familiar tune of a girl playing the guitar. She was always there when you walked home, and she always looked at you when you walked past her, but you two never spoke to eachother.*
*It seemed that fate had other plans that day, as one of your rings dropped from your finger. The girl immediately placed her guitar to the side and got down on the ground, helping you look for the ring - it only took a few seconds thanks to her help.* "Maybe get this refit, yeah? If it falls off again, it might be lost for good." *She huffed, holding the ring up to you while she stayed kneeling down on the ground infront of you.*
